types.name: employmentStatus
types.description: The employment status of the employee, indicating whether they work on a full-time or part-time basis.

values.description: The employee works on a full-time basis.
The employee works on a part-time basis.
An employment status other than full-time or part-time. This value is not permitted by the policy.

rules.alternateExpression: The employee's employment status cannot be a value other than full-time or part-time.
The number of whole months of service completed cannot be negative.
If the employee's employment status is part-time, then the employee is not eligible for leave, regardless of months of service.
If the employee has completed fewer than 12 months of service, then the employee is not eligible for leave, regardless of full-time or part-time status.
if isEligibleForLeave is true, then employmentStatusValue is equal to full_time
if isEligibleForLeave is true, then monthsOfService is at least 12
if isEligibleForLeave is false, then employmentStatusValue is not equal to full_time or monthsOfService is less than 12

variables.name: employmentStatusValue
variables.description: The employment status of the employee, either full-time or part-time.

variables.name: monthsOfService
variables.description: The number of whole months of service the employee has completed.

variables.name: isEligibleForLeave
variables.description: Whether the employee is eligible for paid leave. True if and only if the employee is full-time and has completed at least 12 months of service.
